title: The House of Doors
text: A house in the city has a hundred doors and no walls between them, just doorframes standing in rows like headstones. Each one opens onto a different street, in a different city, under a different sky. Only one of them goes where you need to go.

options.label: The sharpest eye picks the door, and trusts it is the right one.

outcomes.text: The right street, under the right sky.
The wrong street, and the wrong crowd, and they have been waiting.

options.label: Open them all, and see what every city holds.

outcomes.text: Behind one, a merchant's vault. Behind the others, things you do not talk about.

options.label: The slowest props a door open, so you have a way back if you need one.

outcomes.text: A way back, if you need it, and it feels like a hand on the shoulder.
